routes.label: through the embassy, on the CNEDOGE portal

note: The embassy in Washington lists new biometric passports and renewals for its citizens, through the CNEDOGE portal after consular registration, at 50 dollars. The fee in Equatorial Guinea, validity and processing time aren't read: CNEDOGE's own site fails its TLS handshake and no other source was found.
